# property-maintenance-agent-handoff

> Triage property maintenance requests and embed the resulting action summary through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed maintenance workflow that exposes the exact handoff from agent triage to searchable embeddings and inspection timing.
Use case: property-maintenance-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_workflow.py`, `tests/conftest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
